title: Heal Plugin
description: A simple and lightweight plugin to instantly heal and feed players with a single command.
body:
## Overview
HealPlugin is a lightweight server plugin that allows administrators to instantly restore health, food, and saturation for any player on the server.

### Features
* **Instant Healing:** Restores player health to maximum.
* **Feed & Saturation:** Fully regenerates the food bar and sets saturation.
* **Targeting:** Can heal yourself or any other online player.

### Commands & Permissions
* `/heal <player>` — Main command to restore health and food.
  * *Permission:* `healplugin.use` (or Operator status)
